input.quote: Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 provides automatic renewals of one (1) year each — not multi-year — and either party (including us) may opt out on just thirty (30) days' written notice before the end of the initial term or any renewal term. That is a 30-day non-renewal window and a 12-month renewal term, which meets the preferred position (and is well inside the ≤60-day fallback and far from the >90-day walk-away). Exhibit pricing states MarketSite.net and maintenance/support fees for "Year 1" and "Year 2-5, and beyond," and the document contains no renewal-period uplift or repricing mechanic, so there is no uncapped escalator to cap. Two sub-elements of the preferred position are absent — a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and an express CPI/3% cap on any future increase — but these are minor mechanics noted here rather than material failures, so no redline is proposed.
